supports: A deterministic qe_guard 1.1.0 plan and input-audit contract for one explicitly named initial candidate, conditional on an audit pass.
does_not_support: A relaxed geometry, adsorption energy, preferred site, coverage trend, numerical-convergence claim, or transferable parameter recommendation.

limitations: The minimum workflow is not a universal complete workflow.
Material-, model-, and observable-specific controls may add stages and convergence dimensions.
The 1.0e-8 Ry total-energy tolerance is the declared input-level SCF threshold for the guard plan; it is not evidence of cutoff, k-mesh, vacuum, slab, site, or adsorption-energy convergence.

model.adsorbate: one H atom at the initial fcc hollow candidate

objective: Input-level QE 7.5 SCF audit for one unrelaxed Al(111)-H fcc-hollow candidate.

resource_suggestion.cost_boundary: A planning estimate only; queue time, node policy, actual wall time, and memory use are not measured by this case. The 17-atom n=1 entry is intended as a small runtime smoke, not a convergence setting.
